_comment: Stage 3 — UC synced table (reverse ETL) spec for Lakebase Autoscaling. Used with: databricks postgres create-synced-table dev_churn_serving_pg.public.churn_serving --json @serving/synced_table.json. SNAPSHOT = one-time/on-demand full copy (no Change Data Feed needed). Switch to TRIGGERED for scheduled refresh once CDF is enabled on the source (ALTER TABLE dev_churn.gold.churn_serving SET TBLPROPERTIES (delta.enableChangeDataFeed = true)).
